record.label: Scalar CP3 action-gap feature split
record.summary: A grouped five-fold rank-0 screen adds standardized CP3 K3 action to the existing deployment-native feature baseline. Aggregate cross-fit MSE changes from 5.397469699e-9 to 5.397630557e-9, a relative reduction of -2.9803e-5; per-layer CP3/gap correlations remain between about -0.0026 and 0.0404. The scalar split is nonpromotable.
record.terminal_criterion: Closed for the standardized scalar CP3 K3-action read. This does not close distinct off-diagonal K21/action-source features.
